2.title: Clear Pathways to Europe
2.description: Guidance for Ausbildung, nursing preparation and university pathways in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

3.title: Supportive Learning Community
3.description: Personal attention, experienced instructors and a campus culture focused on student success.

0.a: We offer German, English, Spanish, French, Mandarin Chinese, Kiswahili, Arabic, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Dutch and Turkish. German is our flagship pathway for Ausbildung and study in Germany.

1.a: Ausbildung is Germany's dual vocational training system. It combines practical workplace training with classroom instruction and typically includes a stipend. Many programmes require German at B1 or B2 level.

2.q: Do you help with university admission in Germany?
2.a: We provide German language training to the levels commonly required for university admission and share guidance on the application process. We do not guarantee admission or visas.

3.a: We are located at Newline Building, Narok, Kenya.

4.a: Our next major intake is September 2026. Contact us for current availability and short-course schedules.

5.a: Use the Apply Now button to open the admissions form, or contact us by phone, email or WhatsApp for guidance.
